kept: 초록: 'This paper demonstrates how to apply machine learning algorithms to distinguish good stocks from the bad stocks. To this end, we construct 244 technical and fundamental features to characterize each stock, and label stocks according to their ranking with respect to the return-to-volatility ratio.' 표적·라벨(§III): 'We use feature vector Xi(t) ∈ Rn to characterize the behavior of the ith stock up to the tth trading day and assign the return-to-volatility ratio yi(t, f) to Xi(t) assessing the performance of the ith stock during trading period [t+1, t+f]' · 'which is exactly the basic idea of Sharpe Ratio' · 'We rank stocks with respect to their return-to-volatility ratios and label the top and bottom Q percent stocks as positive and negative respectively.' · 'Label the top Q percent as positive, i.e. yi(t, f) := 1' · 'Label the bottom Q percent as negative, i.e. yi(t, f) := 0' · 'Discard the samples in the middle.' · 'To avoid data overlapping, at most ⌊2QTM/(100(1+f))⌋ samples can be labeled.' · 'Fig. 1. shows how to split data.' 데이터: 'The training dataset is constructed from Chinese stock data ranging from 2012.08.08 to 2013.02.01 and the testing dataset is constructed from 2013.02.04 to 2013.03.08.' 모델 — LR: 'Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) with Nesterov momentum and learning rate decay' · 'minimize the log-likelihood loss function' · Table I 'Initial Learning Rate 10⁻²; Learning Rate Decay Rate 10⁻⁶; Training Epochs 20; Momentum Coefficient 0.9'. RF: Table II 'Number of Trees 100; Maximal Tree Depth 4; Minimal Samples Number of Split 2; Minimal Impurity of Split 10⁻⁷'. DNN: Table III 'Input Tensor 128 × n · FC + L2 Regularizer 128 × ⌊n/2⌋ · ReLU · Dropout · FC + L2 Regularizer 128 × ⌊n/4⌋ · ReLU · Batch-Normalization · FC + L2 Regularizer 128 × 2 · Softmax' · Table IV 'Dropout Rate 0.5; L2 Penalty Coefficient 0.01; Momentum Coefficient 0.9; Initial Learning Rate 10⁻³; Learning Rate Decay Rate 10⁻⁶; Training Epochs 20' · 'SGD with Nesterov momentum and learning rate decay'. Stacking: 'We first partition the original training dataset into three disjoint sets, named as Train-1, Train-2, and Validation. Train-1 and Train-2 serve as the training set of based-level classifiers, in which the DNN is trained on the concatenation of Train-1 and Train-2 and RF is trained solely on Train-2.' · 'LR is selected as meta-level algorithm' · 'inputs to LR is the predictions from trained-DNN and trained-RF on the Validation' · 'Stacking is most effective if its based-level algorithms are uncorrelated.' 특성선택: 'GA picks a subset of 114 features and the prediction performances of all models remain almost unchanged after the selection procedure, which suggests some features are indeed redundant.' 평가·포트폴리오(§V): 'Stacking … AUC score of 0.972' · Table VI(선택 후) 'Accuracy 0.919; Precision 0.904; Recall 0.938' · 'There is a setback of our statistical evaluation procedure, i.e. only the stocks in the Q percent tail and head are included in the test sets, which means we only test our model in the unequivocal test samples. pit_notes.signal_date: 각 완결 달력월의 마지막 거래일 d_j. 특성 = d_j 이하 데이터(일간 창 · 회귀 창 = 시장 격자 252 거래일 ≤ d_j · 회계 = usable ≤ d_j 인 최신 분기(캐리 ≤ 400일) · 컨센서스 = 관측 ≤ d_j(캐리 ≤ 35/130일) · 시총 = d_j). 러너 집행 = 익월 첫 거래일.
pit_notes.training_set: 횡단면 m ∈ {j−6..j−1} 의 (특성_m, y_m) — y_m = 달 m+1 의 일간수익 평균/표준편차 · 달 m+1 의 마지막 거래일 d_{m+1} ≤ d_j 에 실현. 시그널 횡단면 j 의 y(달 j+1 · 미실현)는 학습에 들어가지 않는다(코드: cs = MEnd[j−6..j−1] · TR = Date ∈ cs ∧ !is.na(y)).
pit_notes.labels_in_R: R 은 전 기간 표적을 한 번에 계산해 월말 행에 붙이지만(달 MI 의 통계 → 달 MI−1 월말 행) 소비는 §9 의 cs 필터가 시그널 j 기준으로만 한다.
pit_notes.cross_sectional_stats: 라벨 = 그 월말 횡단면 순위(C1) · winsorize/표준화 통계 = 그 달 학습표본(6 횡단면)만 · 시계열 전 표본 통계 = 신호 경로 0건(XLSX 형식 판별 중앙값 · revenue_fy1 배수 · 단위 정합 진단은 데이터 형식 판별이지 신호가 아니다 · 배수는 횡단면 상수라 표준화 후 소멸). 하이퍼파라미터 = 논문 Table I~IV 고정(C12 해당 없음).
pit_notes.fundamentals: C4: 3월 분기 5/15 · 6월 8/15 · 9월 11/15 · 12월(연간) 익년 3/31 → roll join usable ≤ 월말 · 캐리 ≤ 400일. TTM 은 분기 격자 위 연속 4분기(미래 분기 없음) · 직전 연도·5년 = QI−4k(과거만).
pit_notes.consensus: 관측일 ≤ 월말 · 캐리 ≤ 35(sue 130) 달력일 · 개정 lag = 거래일 격자 20/60행 전 날짜의 as-of 관측(과거).
pit_notes.membership: 각 날 RAWDATA 행의 (K200 == TRUE | KQ150 == TRUE)(C6) — 러너 .apply_universe 와 같은 술어라 러너 필터는 0행 제거.
pit_notes.factor_db: 미사용 — C13(부호 정렬)·C15(파케이 직접 로드)·C14(IC 접근)·C17/C18 대상 코드 없음. 컨센서스·회계 파케이는 원천 데이터 패널이며 arrow 로 읽는다.
